# I need to see which servers this host trusts.
Get-ADComputer -Filter * | Select-Object Name

# Step 2: check which of them hold the finance share
Get-SmbShare | Where-Object Name -match 'fin'

# FIN-01 is the highest-value target here.
Test-Connection FIN-01 -Count 1

# verifying access before moving to the next target
Test-Path \\FIN-01\finance$
